## Pathogen-specific treatment

Certain respiratory pathogens that are usually treated in unique ways are listed
here. Other respiratory pathogens are treated with drugs effective for
pneumonia and active against identified organisms. Refer to pathogen-specific
treatment regimen below for recommendation.
